#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Quantized pipeline: reproducible analysis script (12 steps).

Re-runs the recorded data pipeline headless with the public quantized.api
(pip install quantized-lab). It runs in this process: no app or server is needed,
and the project open in the app is not changed. Steps with no quantized.api
equivalent are kept as comments that say so.

Usage: python <this file> [INPUT ...] [--out OUT]
  INPUT  the file(s) the pipeline imports, in order (default: the recorded names)
  OUT    where the final data goes: .csv, .tsv or .xlsx (default pipeline_output.csv)
"""

import argparse
import sys

import quantized.api as qz

RECORDED_INPUTS = ["z.csv"]


def main(argv=None):
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Re-run a recorded Quantized pipeline.")
    parser.add_argument("inputs", nargs="*", help="input file(s), in import order")
    parser.add_argument("--out", default="pipeline_output.csv", help="output table (.csv/.tsv/.xlsx)")
    args = parser.parse_args(argv)
    if hasattr(sys.stdout, "reconfigure"):  # labels may hold μ etc.; a cp1252 console must not crash
        sys.stdout.reconfigure(errors="backslashreplace")
    if not args.inputs and None not in RECORDED_INPUTS:
        args.inputs = list(RECORDED_INPUTS)
    if len(args.inputs) != len(RECORDED_INPUTS):
        parser.error(f"give {len(RECORDED_INPUTS)} input file(s)")
    data = None
    formulas = []  # the formula columns (name, expression), recomputed after each correction

    # 1. Import z.csv
    data = qz.load(args.inputs[0])
    raw = data  # the uncorrected base that corrections start from
    roles = qz.seed_error_roles(data)  # the error-column roles the app gives the file on import

    # 2. Add column dbl
    base = data  # the worksheet before its formula columns
    formulas.append({"name": "dbl", "expr": "2 * A", "unit": "Ω"})
    data = qz.add_formula_columns(base, formulas)

    # 3. Add column rate
    formulas.append({"name": "rate", "expr": "A / x", "unit": "Ω/Hz"})
    data = qz.add_formula_columns(base, formulas)

    # 4. Add column reA
    formulas.append({"name": "reA", "expr": "re(A)", "unit": "Ω"})
    data = qz.add_formula_columns(base, formulas)

    # 5. Add column imA
    formulas.append({"name": "imA", "expr": "im(A)", "unit": "Ω"})
    data = qz.add_formula_columns(base, formulas)

    # 6. Add column cjB
    formulas.append({"name": "cjB", "expr": "conj(B)", "unit": "Ω"})
    data = qz.add_formula_columns(base, formulas)

    # 7. Add column absB
    formulas.append({"name": "absB", "expr": "abs(B)", "unit": "Ω"})
    data = qz.add_formula_columns(base, formulas)

    # 8. Add column argB
    formulas.append(("argB", "arg(B)"))
    data = qz.add_formula_columns(base, formulas)

    # 9. Add column mag
    formulas.append({"name": "mag", "expr": "abs(complex(A, B))", "unit": "Ω"})
    data = qz.add_formula_columns(base, formulas)

    # 10. Add column bad
    # the app added this column WITHOUT a unit: its operands' units contradicted each other
    formulas.append(("bad", "A + x"))
    data = qz.add_formula_columns(base, formulas)

    # 11. Add column Z (re)
    formulas.append({"name": "Z (re)", "expr": "re(complex(A, B) * exp(complex(0, x / 1e4)))", "unit": "Ω"})
    data = qz.add_formula_columns(base, formulas)

    # 12. Add column Z (im)
    formulas.append({"name": "Z (im)", "expr": "im(complex(A, B) * exp(complex(0, x / 1e4)))", "unit": "Ω"})
    data = qz.add_formula_columns(base, formulas)

    if data is None:
        print("nothing to save: no step loaded data")
        return 1
    qz.save_table(data, args.out, overwrite=True, protect=args.inputs)  # replaces --out, never an input
    print(f"saved {args.out}")
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())
